title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows by J.K. Rowling
description:
Novels and Nibbles steps into a world of enchanted forests, hidden secrets, and extraordinary bravery. Harry Potter’s journey is one of courage, sacrifice, and the enduring power of love. As darkness spreads across the wizarding world, Harry, Ron, and Hermione leave behind the safety of Hogwarts to embark on their most dangerous quest yet, to seek and destroy the fragments of Voldemort’s soul hidden throughout the world. Along the way, they uncover the ancient mystery of the Deathly Hallows and discover that true magic lies not in power, but in friendship, loyalty, and the choices we make. A spellbinding play on French onion soup!

We have created a spellbinding play on the Harry Potter French Onion Soup with tender farfalle pasta enveloped in a luxuriously creamy sauce of slow-caramelized onions, rich beef stock, and fragrant fresh thyme and rosemary. Tossed with crispy pancetta and finished with nutty Parmesan and Gruyère cheeses, then crowned with a blanket of toasted, bubbling Gruyère and a sprinkle of fresh parsley. Served alongside a warm, toasted baguette for savoring every last magical bite.
